name: PFacet
description: PFacet (particle facet) geometry (see [Effeindzourou2016]_, [Effeindzourou2015a]_). It is highly recommended to use the helper functions in yade.gridpfacet (e.g., gridpfacet.pfacetCreator1-4) to generate correct PFacet<PFacet> elements.

attributes.name: node1
attributes.description: First Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: node2
attributes.description: Second Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: node3
attributes.description: third Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: conn1
attributes.description: First Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: conn2
attributes.description: Second Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: conn3
attributes.description: third Body the Pfacet is connected to.

attributes.name: cellDist
attributes.description: Distance of bodies in cell size units, if using periodic boundary conditions. Note that periodic boundary conditions for PFacets have not yet been fully implemented.

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
